name: Typography Scale Punch

behavior.description: A short scale punch reveals one selected type or brand layer with a restrained overshoot and a single settling correction.
behavior.targetSelection: Targets are alternatives, not requirements or a combined selection. Choose one present data-animate hook name in the selected component and animate its matching elements together; leave other hook names untouched.
behavior.keyframeTiming: at is seconds from start; each easing applies to the interval ending at the next keyframe.

adaptation: Compose scale as a multiplier of authored base scale and rotation as an additive degree offset. Translation offsets use design pixels at 1080x1920 scaled with the frame; opacity is absolute. Do not replace rotated word variants, layout, fonts, decorative clip-path or authored background treatment. Transform inline text through a layout-preserving motion layer. A selected background or logo receives the same motion without implying a scene transition. Initialize at scheduled start and retain the final authored pose.
